title: 第7章 天赋加持第8章 蒸蒸日上
content_zh:
;;
“天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒。”
“日月盈昃，辰宿列张。”
“寒来暑往，秋收冬藏。”
.......
清晨。
许川教两小只千字文。
他书写了两份，每人手里一份。
且亲手打造了一套适合他们身高的桌椅，方便他们学习。
他读一句，两人对应纸张上的文字，也跟着读一句。
清脆的童音回荡在整个小院，公鸡和母鸡们都是出笼，在院子里溜达，四处啄食。
灶房上空有袅袅的青烟在徐徐上升。
吃过早饭。
白静抱着小儿子，监督许明巍和许明渊进行抄写。
两人一笔一画，写得十分认真。
许川则开始了宅子改造工作，设计，材料，找人帮工，忙得不亦乐乎。
不过，即便如此，他每天还是会抽出时间去田地还有山林转上一圈。
看看情况，除除草之类的。
然后也会练上一个时辰的《小龙象功》。
【天道酬勤】，持之以恒，方能有所收获。

时间一晃过去一月半。
许家的宅子已然大变样。
成了有五间堂屋，有厅堂，有半亩院子的宅院。
在整个洞溪村，都能算中上。
新房建成，会有暖房的习俗，又免不了一顿宴请，当然也会收礼。
————————
岁月弹指即过。
转眼就到了岁祭。
在许川的每日教导，还有白静的严厉监督下，许明巍已经认全了千字文，小半的字都已经会写。
许明渊因为年纪还小，还仅仅是处在认字的阶段。
岁祭后。
许川最终做出了决定，给许明巍加持天赋。
【血脉族谱】在二代子嗣出生后，就多出了一页。
并且诞生了五项命格天赋。
分别是【天生神力】、【趋利避害】、【生财有道】、【鹰眼】和【万灵低语】。
这些都是无主天赋，可以加持在许川自己身上。
但这样的念头，他一闪而过。
因为，哪怕都加在他身上，他一个凡人，也分身无暇。
就像现在，即便身负三项命格天赋，但【每日一卦】对于他目前也是用处不大。
一个家族想要壮大，自然要群起群力，同心同德，方是长久之道。
content_en:
;;
"The sky and the earth are dark and yellow, and the universe is primitive."
"The sun and the moon are full, and the stars and constellations are arranged."
“Cold comes and summer comes, autumn harvests and winter stores.”
.......
Early morning.
Xu Chuan taught two little ones a thousand-character essay.
He wrote two copies, one for each person.
He also personally built a set of tables and chairs suitable for their height to facilitate their study.
He read a sentence, and the two of them read a sentence corresponding to the text on the paper.
The clear children's voice echoed throughout the small yard. The roosters and hens were coming out of their cages, wandering around the yard, pecking around.
There was a curl of green smoke rising slowly over the kitchen.
Had breakfast.
Bai Jing held her youngest son in her arms and supervised Xu Mingwei and Xu Mingyuan's copying.
The two of them wrote stroke by stroke with great care.
Xu Chuan started the renovation work of the house, designing, making materials, and finding helpers. He was very busy.
However, even so, he still takes time to go around the fields and mountains and forests every day.
Look at the situation, weeding and the like.
Then I will practice "Little Dragon Elephant Kung Fu" for an hour.
【God rewards those who work hard】If you persevere, you will gain something.
Time flies by for a month and a half.
The Xu family's house has changed drastically.
It became a house with five main rooms, a hall, and a half-acre yard.
In the entire Dongxi Village, it can be considered average.
When a new house is built, there will be the custom of warming the house, and a banquet is inevitable, and of course gifts will also be received.
————————
The years pass by in a blink of an eye.
The New Year Festival is here in a blink of an eye.
Under Xu Chuan's daily teaching and Bai Jing's strict supervision, Xu Mingwei has learned the Thousand-Character Classic and can write less than half of the characters.
Because Xu Mingyuan is still young, he is still in the stage of reading.
After the New Year Festival.
Xu Chuan finally made the decision to give Xu Mingwei a talent.
[Bloodline Genealogy] After the birth of the second generation heir, there is an extra page.
And five destiny talents were born.
They are [Innate Divine Power], [Seeking Advantages and Avoiding Disadvantages], [Making Money in a Proper Way], [Eagle Eyes] and [Whispers of All Spirits].
These are all masterless talents that can be blessed on Xu Chuan himself.
But this thought flashed across his mind.
Because, even if it were all added to him, he, a mortal, would have no time to spare.
Just like now, even though he has three destiny talents, [Daily Hexagram] is of little use to him at the moment.
If a family wants to grow stronger, it is natural to work together as a team and work together to achieve long-term success.
